hint.en: The camera's IP address on your network, for example 192.168.1.20. The app updates it by itself when the camera gets a new address.
Keep this on. Only switch it off for old cameras that have no HTTPS.
Leave at 554 unless you changed the RTSP port in the camera.

Live video costs Homey a lot of work. Automatic starts at Low (quick to open) and goes up to Medium when Homey has room, and back down when it gets busy. Low (up to 640 pixels wide) is lightest. Medium and High always stay at that size, unless Homey is about to stop the app.

A live view left open, for example on a wall tablet, keeps Homey busy all the time. After this time the video stops; tap it to watch again. For an always-on screen, the Overview or Visitors widget costs almost nothing.
Size of the camera picture and of pictures sent with flows.
How long the motion alarm stays on after the camera stops seeing motion. Example: 30 keeps it on for half a minute.

label.en: Object Analytics also turns on motion

hint.en: When on, a person or vehicle seen by AXIS Object Analytics also turns on the motion alarm.

label.en: PIR motion sensor counts as motion

hint.en: Only for cameras with a PIR motion sensor, such as the M1065-L. On: the motion alarm also goes on when the sensor senses movement. Off: the sensor only has its own alarm and flow card.

label.en: Track and count people and vehicles

hint.en: Uses AXIS Object Analytics to follow every person, car, truck, bus, bicycle and motorbike the camera sees. You get how many are in view now, how many passed today (with graphs in Insights), which way they went, how long they stayed, a summary and the 'Traffic and visitors', 'Recent visitors' and 'Heatmap' widgets. This makes Homey do more work, so only switch it on for cameras where you need it.
Your own name for this direction, used in flows and widgets. Example: 'Towards the house'. Leave empty for 'Left to right'.
Your own name for this direction, used in flows and widgets. Example: 'Away from the house'. Leave empty for 'Right to left'.
Your own name for this direction, used in flows and widgets. Example: 'Coming up the driveway'. Leave empty for 'Towards the camera'.
Your own name for this direction, used in flows and widgets. Example: 'Going down the driveway'. Leave empty for 'Away from the camera'.
